description: Read twenty-four lines, no song, and named The Two Gentlemen of Verona at two of the clock.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Would not name the week, left last Saturday at thirty shillings, and set Monday's bill.
name: John Heminges

description: Would not invent a share out of two-thirds of a house.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Kept the tally at lines, kept you, and refused a song.
name: Will Kemp

description: Refused to marry twenty-four lines to a share, and repeated the unpaid sums without making them a balance.
name: William Shakespeare
